description: Free: mint a short-lived (15 min), single-use PUT URL for local media. PUT the file via plain HTTP (not MCP), then pass upload_id to speech_transcribe. Size cap matches MaxBytes; rate-limited per client. Not a public file host — bytes are deleted after transcription or expiry.

bytes.description: Optional declared size hint; must not exceed MaxBytes.

contentType.description: Optional Content-Type to recommend on PUT (audio/* or video/*).

name: speech_upload_url
title: Free signed one-time upload URL
